tests.name: Metadata and feed getters never dispatch anonymous workers
Metadata and pages remain anonymous for every account session state
Only categories present in current official metadata may dispatch
Malformed queries and out of range public pages are rejected before dispatch
Default queries coalesce while categories and official orders remain independent
Metadata refresh coalesces and failures retain the last official list
Malformed metadata responses preserve the last usable official category list
Failed first page retains all pages and a successful refresh replaces them atomically
Starting a first page refresh invalidates an older append even if refresh fails
Append coalesces callers and preserves order across duplicate and short nonempty pages
Failed append retries the same page without modifying the cached order
Five remote pages impose an independent ninety comic cap per category and order
Duplicate pages also stop at the fifth remote request
Mismatched category order and page responses cannot replace a cached snapshot
Category snapshot and comic persistence roll back together after a storage failure
Queued anonymous category work rechecks offline suspension and account generation
Offline restart retains metadata query order and the next page without dispatch
Expired metadata still allows offline browsing of saved category feeds
Category editorial projections preserve homepage provenance favorites and exact reading anchors
Category covers require the correct snapshot member and identity
A refreshed category revision rejects old covers before start and after completion
Changed cover URLs cannot authorize downloads through an older category snapshot
Account changes and close discard pending metadata and page callbacks
Account changes invalidate category cover identities and clean late temporary files
Forged credentials are stripped from otherwise valid anonymous category requests
